mapper.insert: INSERT INTO layer_health (layer, day, state, failed_runs, yield, median, miss_share) VALUES (#{o.layer}, #{o.day}, #{o.state}, #{o.failedRuns}, #{o.yield}, #{o.median}, #{o.missShare}) ON CONFLICT (layer, day) DO UPDATE SET state = EXCLUDED.state, failed_runs = EXCLUDED.failed_runs, yield = EXCLUDED.yield, median = EXCLUDED.median, miss_share = EXCLUDED.miss_share
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM layer_health WHERE day > current_date - #{days}::int ORDER BY layer, day DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_layer_coverage (source_id, layer, sightings_28d, misses) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{layer}, #{sightings28d}, #{misses}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, layer) DO UPDATE SET sightings_28d = EXCLUDED.sightings_28d, misses = EXCLUDED.misses, updated = now()
